# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 08 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale volume hits 2026 high in July, but prices soften** - July saw 2,660 HDB resale flats change hands, the highest monthly volume this year, while the resale price index continued to soften and now sits 0.7% below its level a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-2026-high-in-july-as-prices-continue-to-fall/)

- **Bishan executive maisonette sets new all-time HDB resale price record** - A high-floor executive maisonette in Bishan changed hands for S$1.65 million on 4 August 2026, making it both the priciest HDB resale flat in Bishan and Singapore's most expensive executive flat ever sold. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/s1-65m-bishan-maisonette-becomes-singapores-priciest-executive-flat-to-date/)

## En Bloc Reform — Proposed Lower Consent Thresholds

- **Parliament introduces bill to lower en bloc consent thresholds for older developments** - The Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026, introduced on 4 August, proposes reducing the owner-consent requirement for collective sales of developments aged 40–59 years from 80% to 70%. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/proposed-en-bloc-consent-thresholds/)

- **Condos aged 60 and above could face an even lower 65% consent bar under the same proposals** - The proposed reforms would set a further reduced threshold of 65% for developments 60 years old and older, potentially reviving collective sale prospects for Singapore's oldest private residential stock. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-proposal-revive-en-bloc-hopes-for-older-condos/)

- **Lakeside Towers launches third en bloc attempt at unchanged $350 million reserve price** - The 45-year-old development has relaunched its collective sale tender for the third time at $350 million, having previously failed to attract a buyer in 2018, 2022, and 2023. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/this-45-year-old-condo-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-350-million-price-tag/)

## Infrastructure & New Launches

- **Cross Island Line Phase 3 to add four stations extending west to Gul Circle** - Announced on 31 July 2026, CRL Phase 3 will extend the line by approximately 10km from the future Jurong Lake District station to Gul Circle via four new stations. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/cross-island-line-phase-3/)
